_doc: Creates a standardized documentation page with sections for colors, typography, spacing, and effects. Each section is a frame with auto-layout containing labeled swatches/samples.
_usage: Send commands sequentially. Each step creates one documentation section.
_pattern: 1. Create or navigate to documentation page

4_create_swatch_row._doc: Horizontal row of color swatches — create one per color group

_section_template.colors: Swatch grid — 80x80 rounded rects, labeled below, grouped by scale
_section_template.typography: Text samples — one per style, showing font name + size + weight
_section_template.spacing: Spacing bars — horizontal rects showing each spacing value
_section_template.effects: Shadow cards — white rects with each shadow effect applied
_section_template.radius: Radius demo — rects with each corner radius value
